description: Assign or move an item: set its current location, current holder, responsible person or home location. Omit a field to leave it unchanged; pass null to clear the current location or the current holder. The home location and the responsible person can NEVER be cleared — every item has both; to stop overriding the responsible person pass the literal "default" instead, and the item follows its category's or the organization's default again. For the two PERSON fields you may pass the literal "me" instead of an id — it resolves to the key owner's own person record, the same shorthand search_items accepts. Returns the updated item. Setting a holder on an item with open tickets, overdue maintenance or the status defect or in_repair returns { requiresAcknowledgment: true, warnings } instead (warnings.itemStatus names the status) — confirm with your user that the item should be handed out anyway, then retry the SAME call with acknowledgeWarnings: true. Setting a holder on an item that an active order requests (but has not picked yet) returns { requiresAcknowledgment: true, requested } — confirm with your user, then retry with acknowledgeRequested: true. Never pass either acknowledgment flag without that explicit user confirmation. Requires the manager role — a plain member cannot assign anything, not even to themselves with "me"; tell them to ask a manager rather than retrying.

acknowledgeRequested.description: Pass true ONLY after your user explicitly confirmed assigning despite the active order requests from a previous requiresAcknowledgment result

acknowledgeWarnings.description: Pass true ONLY after your user explicitly confirmed the warnings from a previous requiresAcknowledgment result

currentHolderId.description: Person resource id who borrows the item, the literal "me" for the key owner, or null to clear

currentLocationId.description: Location resource id, or null to clear

responsiblePersonId.description: Person resource id, the literal "me" for the key owner, or the literal "default" to hand the item back to the category/organization default chain. It cannot be cleared

name: assign_item

compartment.description: The compartment of that container the item sits in (absent = directly in the container)

container.description: The container this item is packed into, if any

effectiveHolder.description: Holder followed through the container chain

effectiveLocation.description: Location followed through the container chain

instruction.description: What to confirm with your user and how to retry

isDraft.description: Present and true only for an unfinished draft capture

modelId.description: The item's model — pass it as create_order lines[].modelId to order any instance of this model

primaryCode.description: The code printed on the item's asset tag — how a human tells two identical models apart. Absent when no code is attached

quantity.description: How many this row stands for — only on quantity-tracked pools. To count a pool, SUM this; to count serialized items, count rows

requested.description: The active orders that requested this item (.orders names them)

requiresAcknowledgment.description: Present and true when nothing was written and a human confirmation is required — retry the SAME call with the acknowledge flag named in `instruction`

status.description: Condition: available | in_repair | defect | lost | retired ("available" means not defect/lost/retired — the item may still be borrowed)

trackingMode.description: "quantity" for a stock pool counted by amount. Absent = a serialized item, i.e. this row IS one physical thing

warnings.description: Open tickets / overdue maintenance behind a requires-ack round

webUrl.description: Link to this item in the web app — give it to your user so they can look at the record themselves. Absent when the deployment has no public address configured

title: Assign / move item
